reproducibility_note: AgentDojo executes a live model, so runs are not bit-for-bit reproducible. The mediator settings below are pinned; the model is not.
supersedes: Earlier runs reported 0.0% ASR. The taint extractor read `text` from AgentDojo content blocks that carry `content`, so FR-PE-04 never fired and every refusal came from the blanket require_approval_for gate. Fixed in 019e13c.
caveats: One suite of four; travel, banking and slack untested.
Taint is inferred from textual overlap, not tracked at the source, so an injection that constructs a value rather than copying one evades it.
Refusals are not a per-attack count: the agent retries after a refusal.
The allow-list (FR-PE-02) never fired; this suite tests argument provenance, not least agency.
